ui.Купи книгу знань у магазині, і відкриють: Buy a knowledge book in the shop to unlock every recipe and potion.
ui.Ти отримаєш {inviter} монет і скриню за: You get {inviter} coins and a chest for every friend, and your friend gets {friend} coins and a chest to start with.
